parse.title: Legendary Assassin
parse.text:
Overview

Legendary Assassin is a MythicalMythical Limited unit. He can be obtained by summoning the new Assassin Banner.

Evolving

Legendary Assassin can evolve into Legendary Assassin (Prime) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Legendary Assassin
x250 Assassin Token
x6 Star Fruit
x2 Star Fruit (Red)
x2 Star Fruit (Pink)
x2 Star Fruit (Green)
x1 Star Fruit (Rainbow)
Result
Legendary Assassin (Prime)

Before evolving this unit, the unit must have 5000 Takedowns. [1]

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
